name: pull_adb_file
description: Pull one absolute device path (a database, shared-preferences XML, or any readable file) into a caller-selected output directory, digesting it with SHA-256. The local copy must not already exist. Read-only with respect to the device.

__schema0.description: Device serial exactly as `adb devices` reports it

__schema1.description: Absolute device filesystem path to pull

__schema2.description: Local directory for the pulled file; must not already contain the file

device_path.description: Absolute device filesystem path to pull

output_directory.description: Local directory for the pulled file; must not already contain the file

serial.description: Device serial exactly as `adb devices` reports it
